purpose: Test whether retained scripted demonstration prefixes can form a legal probe-return primitive before any active-property policy is designed.
forward_prefix: same light-derived prefix ending 30 actions after first target contact for both mass conditions
return_controller: reverse prefix order, negate six delta-pose components, retain closed-gripper command, then execute ten zero-pose open-gripper actions
legal_inputs: predeclared actions and ordinary controller execution only; no mass, state, segmentation, reward, or success is used for action selection
claim_limit: A pass authorizes design work only; a failure closes this exact inverse-delta expert, not active property grounding or all feedback controllers.
